axes: x=east(m), y=up, z=north(m). 2D points are [east, north].
note: Unity keeps north as +Z. The Three.js slice consumer (QUAHOG_Web/src/slice.ts toWorld) stores the same 2D point as z=-north. Road and water vertices on the square boundary are edge intersections, not additional OSM nodes. A harbour vertex may also be a corner of the clip square when the source polygon covers that corner.
